description: This file contains a Python script implementing Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) for few-shot Omniglot classification using PyTorch and TorchFunc, including training, testing, and plotting functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Sets up data loader, neural network, optimizer, and runs training and testing loops for 100 epochs.

methods.name: loss_for_task
methods.description: Performs inner-loop adaptation of model parameters for a single task and computes query loss and accuracy.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Performs one epoch of meta-training over batches of tasks, updating the meta-parameters.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates the model on test tasks without fine-tuning, recording loss and accuracy.

methods.name: plot
methods.description: Plots training and testing accuracy over epochs and saves the figure.
